wrap_model_ddp: wrap a fairseq model with DistributedDataParallel for distributed training using c10d backend
wrap_model_slowmo: wrap a fairseq model with SlowMo GossipDataParallel for large-scale distributed training
wrap_model_tpu: wrap a fairseq model with TPUDistributedDataParallel for TPU-based distributed training
configure_heartbeat_timeout: configure a heartbeat timeout to kill stalled distributed training jobs automatically
all_reduce_tpu_grads: perform all-reduce gradient synchronization across TPU workers using torch_xla
